entities.name: The Guildless
entities.description: People on Ravnica who belong to none of the ten guilds, a majority of the plane's inhabitants.

entities.name: The Gateless
entities.description: Subgroup of the Guildless that actively resists the ten guilds.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild whose Firemanes led an assault on the Gateless.

entities.name: Nevena
entities.description: Leader of the Gateless, marked for death.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Pact whose collapse preceded the reformation of the guilds.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Ravnican society is fragile.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Notable guildless person, member of the R.A.M.I.

entities.name: R.A.M.I.
entities.description: Detective agency whose members are guildless.

events.summary: After the Guildpact's collapse, random violence afflicts the reformed guilds, carried out by Ravnicans who refuse to join a guild; they are called the Gateless.
Boros Firemanes lead a victorious assault on the rebels; the Gateless mark their leader Nevena for death.
events.quote: Boros Firemanes led a victorious assault on the rebels.

events.summary: Some Angels and Freemages desert to the Gateless.
After the New Phyrexian Invasion the guilds fail to keep up, so civilians deliver services themselves.
events.quote: many began to deliver services by themselves

relations.quote: Boros Firemanes led a victorious assault on the rebels.
